recreation_entertainment_activity.value: Casino gaming and hospitality: Station Casinos and Fertitta Entertainment-branded casino resorts and locals casinos in Las Vegas valley, with dining, hotel, entertainment

venue_service_capacity.value: Roughly two dozen casino properties across the Las Vegas valley, including large resorts like Red Rock and Green Valley Ranch, with slots, table games, hotel rooms, restaurants

admission_yield.value: Casinos do not charge admission; revenue comes from gaming, food, beverage and rooms

pass_membership_mix.value: No pass or membership model; player loyalty program (Boarding Pass) drives repeat local customers

gaming_economics_gaming_businesses.value: Revenue mainly from slot machines and table games at locals casinos; gaming is the largest revenue source, with food, beverage and rooms secondary
